cohort: The study included 140 patients with antepartum hemorrhage in a tertiary care center in Meerut, India.
finding: Antepartum hemorrhage, primarily caused by Placenta previa, is associated with significant maternal and neonatal morbidity, high rates of emergency cesarean sections, and blood transfusions.
mod_finding: Emergency LSCS was the predominant mode of delivery, performed in 70% of cases of antepartum hemorrhage.
